arguments.content: P1 review pattern: input normalization bypasses a policy-owning facade. A small trim/normalization change can silently remove bounded retries if it also replaces a resilient operation with its single-attempt primitive. New tests may mask the regression by asserting the first transient exception instead of the documented logical-read outcome. Verify through the public entry point with success on attempts 1, 2 and 3, transient exhaustion, and permanent errors both initially and after a transient. Preserve normalization at the boundary and delegate to the existing retry-policy owner. Confirmed in staged preference ID normalization review against HEAD 7c0410c18bac40c33f857000ac3cc59d38a02165; reader.py:2. Both candidate tests passed despite public retry regressions.
